text.title: Hidden Tech Debt Trace Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on whether AI-assisted commits exist in the trailing window, whether a test suite and a comparable baseline commit exist, and whether the repository is old enough for a scan to pay back — to a full trace, a baseline-first halt, or skip.

decision-tree.root-question: Are there AI-assisted commits on the default branch in the trailing 3 months?

conclusion.verdict: skip; run the generic tech-debt methodology instead — this trace only reads deltas over an AI-authored change set

branch.question: Does an executable test suite exist for the scanned packages?

conclusion.verdict: skip; the finding is "no tests", not a debt trace — skip, mock-spec and assertion scans all read an empty set

branch.question: Is there a named baseline commit with CI or coverage history on the default branch to diff duplication and suppression counts against?

conclusion.verdict: halt; pin a baseline commit and re-run the detector at the same threshold against it — raw counts without a delta are unreadable as findings
skip; under a month of history the finding rate does not repay the scan cost
apply the full trace: skip/collection inventory, unspecced-mock ratio, assertion-free tests, duplication delta, single-implementer abstractions, suppression density per KLOC
